Our analysis

Of the 108 medium SUVs in our comparison, the Honda CR-V e:HEV is the 37th most expensive to own.

FAQ

How much does a Honda CR-V e:HEV cost per month?

About €650 a month at 15,000 km a year over 5 years, including depreciation, energy, insurance, servicing and road tax. That's €0.520 per km.

Which DGT label does the Honda CR-V e:HEV have?

The ECO label.
